models.title: AlexNet
models.paper_title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
models.core_mech: 以 GPU、ReLU、dropout 和深卷积组合首次规模化训练 ImageNet 级深 CNN。
models.core_mech_en: First large-scale ImageNet-grade deep CNN trained end-to-end by combining dual-GPU parallelism, non-saturating ReLU activations, dropout regularization, and stacked convolutions.
models.input_desc: 224×224 RGB 图像
models.input_en: 224×224 RGB image
models.output_desc: 类别概率或倒数第二层视觉特征
models.output_en: Closed-set class probabilities or penultimate 4096-D visual feature vector

models.title: ResNet
models.paper_title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
models.core_mech: 显式 identity shortcut 与残差相加 y=x+F(x)。
models.core_mech_en: Explicit identity shortcut connections combined with additive residual learning y = x + F(x).
models.input_desc: 2D 图像或 3D 体数据特征
models.input_en: 2D image or 3D volumetric feature tensor
models.output_desc: 分类 logits、金字塔特征或下游编码表示
models.output_en: Classification logits, multi-scale feature pyramid, or downstream encoded representations

models.title: DenseNet
models.paper_title: Densely Connected Convolutional Networks
models.core_mech: 每层对所有前层输出做通道 concat，而非仅连接相邻层或做残差相加。
models.core_mech_en: Every layer concatenates feature maps from all preceding layers along the channel axis rather than summing adjacent residuals.
models.input_desc: 图像或前一 transition 的特征图
models.input_en: Input image or feature maps from the preceding transition block
models.output_desc: 复用全部前层表示的分类或编码特征
models.output_en: Classification logits or multi-scale concatenated dense features reusing all earlier layers

models.title: ConvNeXt
models.paper_title: A ConvNet for the 2020s
models.core_mech: 7×7 depthwise spatial mixer 加 inverted bottleneck 的现代纯卷积块。
models.core_mech_en: Modernized pure ConvNet block pairing a 7×7 depthwise spatial mixer with an inverted channel bottleneck.
models.input_desc: 2D 图像
models.input_en: 2D image tensor
models.output_desc: 四级层级特征或分类 logits
models.output_en: Four-stage hierarchical feature pyramid or classification logits

models.title: VGG-16/19
models.paper_title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
models.core_mech: 以高度同质的 3×3 plain-convolution blocks 规律加深到 16/19 层，无残差连接。
models.core_mech_en: Homogeneous stacking of 3×3 plain convolutional blocks systematically deepened to 16–19 layers without residual shortcuts.
models.input_desc: 固定尺寸 RGB/医学 2D 图像
models.input_en: Fixed-size RGB or 2D grayscale medical image
models.output_desc: 分类 logits 或供下游使用的多层卷积特征
models.output_en: Classification logits or multi-stage intermediate convolutional feature maps

models.title: GoogLeNet / Inception-v1
models.paper_title: Going Deeper with Convolutions
models.core_mech: 在每个 Inception module 中并行执行 1×1、降维后 3×3/5×5 和 pooling 分支，再通道拼接。
models.core_mech_en: Parallel multi-scale branches (1×1, bottlenecked 3×3, 5×5 convolutions, and pooling) concatenated within each Inception module.
models.input_desc: 2D 图像
models.input_en: 2D image tensor
models.output_desc: 全局分类 logits 与多尺度中间特征
models.output_en: Global classification logits and multi-scale intermediate representations

models.title: ResNeXt
models.paper_title: Aggregated Residual Transformations for Deep Neural Networks
models.core_mech: 在 residual bottleneck 中以 cardinality 控制的 grouped 3×3 convolution 聚合多个等拓扑变换。
models.core_mech_en: Aggregates multiple homogeneous residual branches via grouped 3×3 convolutions governed by a cardinality hyperparameter.
models.input_desc: 图像或上一 stage 特征
models.input_en: Input image or preceding stage feature map
models.output_desc: 分组聚合残差特征与分类/下游输出
models.output_en: Grouped aggregated residual representations and downstream task predictions

models.title: SENet
models.paper_title: Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks
models.core_mech: 全局平均池化 squeeze 后经 bottleneck MLP 产生每通道 sigmoid 门，对卷积特征逐通道重标定。
models.core_mech_en: Global average pooling (Squeeze) followed by a lightweight bottleneck MLP (Excitation) producing per-channel sigmoid gates.
models.input_desc: 卷积 block 的多通道特征 X
models.input_en: Multi-channel convolutional feature tensor X
models.output_desc: 输入自适应通道重标定后的特征或任务预测
models.output_en: Input-adaptively channel-recalibrated feature tensor or classification output

models.title: EfficientNet
models.paper_title: EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks
models.core_mech: 以 NAS 设计的 MBConv+SE 基线配合 depth/width/resolution 三维 compound scaling。
models.core_mech_en: NAS-discovered MBConv+SE baseline scaled jointly across depth, width, and input resolution via a compound coefficient φ.
models.input_desc: 2D 图像与缩放系数 phi
models.input_en: 2D image scaled according to compound coefficient φ
models.output_desc: 效率优化的分类 logits 或层级特征
models.output_en: Compute-efficient classification logits or multi-scale feature pyramid

models.title: FCN
models.paper_title: Fully Convolutional Networks for Semantic Segmentation
models.core_mech: FC→Conv 的整图 dense prediction，加 pool3/pool4 分数级 skip fusion。
models.core_mech_en: Converts image-level FC layers into 1×1 convolutions for arbitrary-size dense prediction with pool3/pool4 skip score fusion.
models.input_desc: 任意尺寸 2D 图像
models.input_en: Arbitrary-size 2D image
models.output_desc: 与输入对齐的像素级类别 logits
models.output_en: Pixel-aligned semantic class probability map

models.title: U-Net
models.paper_title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
models.core_mech: 对称 U 形多尺度解码器与 encoder–decoder 同尺度 concat long skips。
models.core_mech_en: Symmetric U-shaped multi-scale decoder coupled with same-scale encoder–decoder channel concatenation long skips.
models.input_desc: 2D 生物医学图像
models.input_en: 2D biomedical microscopy or radiological image
models.output_desc: 逐像素前景/多类别分割图
models.output_en: Pixel-accurate foreground or multi-class segmentation map

models.title: 3D U-Net
models.paper_title: 3D U-Net: Learning Dense Volumetric Segmentation from Sparse Annotation
models.core_mech: 把 U-Net 的卷积、池化、上采样和 long skip 全部扩展为原生 3D，并支持稀疏切片监督。
models.core_mech_en: Extends all U-Net convolutions, pooling, upsampling, and long skips to native 3D tensors with support for sparse slice annotations.
models.input_desc: 3D CT/MRI 子体积或完整体数据
models.input_en: 3D CT/MRI sub-volume or whole volumetric scan
models.output_desc: 稠密 3D 体素分割
models.output_en: Dense 3D voxel-wise segmentation volume

models.title: V-Net
models.paper_title: V-Net: Fully Convolutional Neural Networks for Volumetric Medical Image Segmentation
models.core_mech: 3D residual FCN 与直接可微 Dice overlap objective 的结合。
models.core_mech_en: Volumetric 3D residual encoder–decoder trained directly with a differentiable Dice overlap objective.
models.input_desc: 3D 医学体数据
models.input_en: 3D medical imaging volume
models.output_desc: 前景概率体或多类体素分割
models.output_en: Foreground probability volume or multi-class voxel segmentation

models.title: nnU-Net
models.paper_title: nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation
models.core_mech: dataset fingerprint 驱动的自配置、交叉验证与推理后处理闭环，而不是单一新算子。
models.core_mech_en: Dataset-fingerprint-driven self-configuration, 5-fold cross-validation ensembling, and post-processing loop rather than a new neural block.
models.input_desc: 带影像、标签与 spacing 元数据的新分割数据集
models.input_en: New medical segmentation dataset with raw images, masks, and physical voxel spacing metadata
models.output_desc: 经交叉验证选择和后处理的可复现分割系统
models.output_en: Self-configured, cross-validated, and post-processed end-to-end segmentation system

models.title: UNETR
models.paper_title: UNETR: Transformers for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
models.core_mech: 多深度 ViT token skips 连接到卷积 U 形解码器的 3D hybrid。
models.core_mech_en: 3D hybrid segmentation architecture connecting multi-depth Vision Transformer token representations to a convolutional U-shaped decoder.
models.input_desc: 3D 医学体数据
models.input_en: 3D medical imaging volume
models.output_desc: 高分辨率 3D 语义分割
models.output_en: High-resolution 3D volumetric semantic segmentation

models.title: Swin UNETR (SSL)
models.paper_title: Self-Supervised Pre-Training of Swin Transformers for 3D Medical Image Analysis
models.core_mech: 3D shifted-window hierarchy 与旋转、重建、对比联合自监督的 Swin UNETR。
models.core_mech_en: 3D shifted-window hierarchical Swin encoder coupled to a U-shaped CNN decoder and pretrained with multi-task 3D self-supervision.
models.input_desc: 未标注 3D CT 子体积；微调时输入带标签体数据
models.input_en: Unlabeled 3D CT sub-volumes for pretraining; labeled 3D volumes for fine-tuning
models.output_desc: 预训练层级编码器及下游 3D 分割
models.output_en: Pretrained hierarchical 3D Swin encoder and dense downstream volumetric segmentation

models.title: MedNeXt
models.paper_title: MedNeXt: Transformer-driven Scaling of ConvNets for Medical Image Segmentation
models.core_mech: 贯穿 encoder、decoder 和上下采样的全 3D 大核 depthwise ConvNeXt block。
models.core_mech_en: Fully 3D large-kernel depthwise ConvNeXt blocks deployed uniformly across encoder, bottleneck, decoder, and residual up/downsampling.
models.input_desc: 3D 医学影像 patch
models.input_en: 3D medical imaging patch
models.output_desc: 多尺度深监督的 3D 分割 logits
models.output_en: Multi-scale deep-supervised 3D segmentation logits

models.title: Models Genesis
models.paper_title: Models Genesis: Generic Autodidactic Models for 3D Medical Image Analysis
models.core_mech: 多种 3D 变形与遮挡的统一恢复式自监督，而非从 2D ImageNet 迁移。
models.core_mech_en: Unified restorative 3D self-supervised learning from non-linear intensity, local pixel shuffling, and in-/out-painting perturbations.
models.input_desc: 未标注 3D CT 子体积
models.input_en: Unlabeled 3D CT/MRI sub-volumes
models.output_desc: 可迁移的 3D encoder 表示
models.output_en: Transferable 3D encoder-decoder representations for segmentation and classification

models.title: VISTA3D
models.paper_title: VISTA3D: A Unified Segmentation Foundation Model for 3D Medical Imaging
models.core_mech: 127 类自动分支、3D 点提示分支和 supervoxel 蒸馏共存的统一 3D segmentation FM。
models.core_mech_en: Unified 3D CT segmentation foundation model integrating a 127-class automated branch, a 3D point-prompt branch, and 2D supervoxel distillation.
models.input_desc: 3D CT 与可选点提示/目标类别
models.input_en: 3D CT volume with optional 3D click coordinates or target anatomical class IDs
models.output_desc: 已知类别自动 mask 或提示条件下的 3D mask
models.output_en: Automated 127-class 3D segmentation masks or interactive point-prompted 3D masks (including zero-shot novel structures)

models.title: Mask2Former
models.paper_title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation
models.core_mech: 上一层预测 mask 反向约束下一层 query cross-attention 的迭代集合分割。
models.core_mech_en: Iterative set-prediction segmentation where predicted foreground masks from layer l-1 constrain query cross-attention in layer l.
models.input_desc: 二维图像
models.input_en: 2D image
models.output_desc: 一组带类别的二值 mask，可统一实例、语义与全景分割
models.output_en: Set of class-labeled binary masks unifying semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation

models.title: U-Net++
models.paper_title: UNet++: Redesigning Skip Connections to Exploit Multiscale Features in Image Segmentation
models.core_mech: 以 X_i,j 嵌套稠密卷积节点重写 U-Net 跳连，并从多个顶层节点施加深监督。
models.core_mech_en: Rewrites U-Net skip pathways as a dense nested grid of intermediate convolutional nodes X_{i,j} with multi-depth deep supervision.
models.input_desc: 2D/3D 医学图像
models.input_en: 2D or 3D medical image
models.output_desc: 深监督融合或选定深度的分割概率图
models.output_en: Deeply supervised ensemble or depth-pruned segmentation probability map

models.title: Attention U-Net
models.paper_title: Attention U-Net: Learning Where to Look for the Pancreas
models.core_mech: 由粗尺度 decoder gating signal 计算空间 attention coefficients，在拼接前逐位置筛选 encoder skip。
models.core_mech_en: Computes spatial soft-attention coefficients α ∈ [0,1] from coarse decoder gating signals to filter encoder skips prior to concatenation.
models.input_desc: 医学图像
models.input_en: 2D or 3D medical image
models.output_desc: 经空间注意力门筛选 skip features 的分割图
models.output_en: Segmentation map decoded from spatially gated skip connections

models.title: H-DenseUNet
models.paper_title: H-DenseUNet: Hybrid Densely Connected UNet for Liver and Tumor Segmentation From CT Volumes
models.core_mech: 先以 2D DenseUNet 学切片内细节，再将特征堆叠进 3D DenseUNet，并通过 hybrid feature fusion 联合预测。
models.core_mech_en: Extracts intra-slice features via a 2D DenseUNet, stacks them into a 3D DenseUNet, and fuses both via a hybrid feature fusion (HFF) layer.
models.input_desc: 高分辨率腹部 CT 体
models.input_en: High-resolution volumetric abdominal CT scan
models.output_desc: 肝脏/肿瘤 3D 分割概率体
models.output_en: 3D volumetric liver and tumor segmentation probability volume

models.title: SegFormer
models.paper_title: SegFormer: Simple and Efficient Design for Semantic Segmentation with Transformers
models.core_mech: 层级 MiT 编码器结合 overlap patch、K/V 缩减 attention 与含 depthwise Conv 的 Mix-FFN，再接全 MLP 轻量 decoder。
models.core_mech_en: Hierarchical Mix Transformer (MiT) encoder with overlapping patches, sequence-reduced attention, and 3×3 depthwise Mix-FFN paired with an all-MLP decoder.
models.input_desc: 任意常见分辨率的 2D 图像
models.input_en: 2D image of arbitrary test resolution
models.output_desc: 全分辨率语义分割概率图
models.output_en: Full-resolution semantic segmentation probability map

models.title: S4
models.paper_title: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
models.core_mech: 结构化 A 矩阵使线性 SSM 可在长卷积训练与递推推理间等价切换。
models.core_mech_en: Parameterizes state matrix A as Normal Plus Low-Rank (NPLR) so linear SSMs switch exact equivalence between O(N log N) convolutional training and O(1) recurrent inference.
models.input_desc: 长一维序列 x1…xN
models.input_en: Long 1D sequence x_1 … x_N
models.output_desc: 保留长程历史的序列表示 y1…yN
models.output_en: Long-range sequence representation y_1 … y_N preserving distant history

models.title: Mamba
models.paper_title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
models.core_mech: 由当前输入生成 Δ、B、C 的 selective SSM，并用硬件感知并行 scan 执行。
models.core_mech_en: Makes SSM discretization step Δ and projections B, C functions of the current input x_k, executed via a hardware-aware parallel associative scan.
models.input_desc: 长度 N 的 token/连续信号序列
models.input_en: Sequence of N tokens or continuous signal samples
models.output_desc: 内容选择后的长程序列表示
models.output_en: Content-selectively filtered long-range sequence representations

models.title: VMamba
models.paper_title: VMamba: Visual State Space Model
models.core_mech: SS2D 将二维网格沿四个方向 selective scan 后再逆映射融合。
models.core_mech_en: 2D Selective Scan (SS2D) unfolds spatial feature maps along four directional traversal paths, applies selective SSMs, and merges them back.
models.input_desc: 2D 图像
models.input_en: 2D image tensor
models.output_desc: 层级视觉特征或分类 logits
models.output_en: Four-stage hierarchical visual feature maps or classification logits

models.title: U-Mamba
models.paper_title: U-Mamba: Enhancing Long-range Dependency for Biomedical Image Segmentation
models.core_mech: 在 nnU-Net 风格 residual CNN encoder/bottleneck 中插入 selective SSM，同时保留 CNN long skips。
models.core_mech_en: Embeds flattened 1D selective Mamba blocks inside an nnU-Net-style residual CNN encoder/bottleneck while retaining CNN decoder and long skips.
models.input_desc: 2D/3D 医学影像与 nnU-Net 数据配置
models.input_en: 2D or 3D medical image within the automated nnU-Net pipeline
models.output_desc: 逐像素/体素分割
models.output_en: Dense pixel- or voxel-level segmentation map

models.title: SegMamba
models.paper_title: SegMamba: Long-range Sequential Modeling Mamba For 3D Medical Image Segmentation
models.core_mech: GSC + Tri-oriented Mamba 的 TSMamba block，以及 FUE 过滤的多尺度 skip。
models.core_mech_en: Combines Gated Spatial Convolution (GSC) with Tri-oriented Mamba (ToM) scans along axial, coronal, and sagittal axes plus Feature Uncertainty Estimation (FUE) skips.
models.input_desc: 3D 医学体数据
models.input_en: 3D volumetric medical scan (CT / MRI)
models.output_desc: 多尺度融合的 3D 分割
models.output_en: Multi-scale fused 3D volumetric segmentation

models.title: Transformer
models.paper_title: Attention Is All You Need
models.core_mech: 无递归的多头 self-attention encoder 与 masked self-/cross-attention decoder。
models.core_mech_en: Recurrence-free multi-head self-attention encoder paired with a masked self- and cross-attention decoder.
models.input_desc: 源 token 序列与右移后的目标 token 序列
models.input_en: Source token sequence and right-shifted target token sequence
models.output_desc: 自回归目标 token 概率
models.output_en: Autoregressive target token probabilities or contextualized sequence embeddings

models.title: Vision Transformer (ViT)
models.paper_title: An Image Is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
models.core_mech: 非重叠 patch 线性 token 化、CLS 汇聚与全局 Transformer encoder，完全移除卷积主干。
models.core_mech_en: Splits images into non-overlapping patches, linearly projects them into tokens with positional embeddings, and processes them via a pure global Transformer encoder.
models.input_desc: 固定分辨率二维图像
models.input_en: Fixed-resolution 2D image (or 3D sub-volume patches)
models.output_desc: CLS 全局表征或类别概率
models.output_en: Global [CLS] representation, patch token grid, or classification logits

models.title: Swin Transformer
models.paper_title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
models.core_mech: W-MSA 与 SW-MSA 交替实现局部高效注意力和跨窗连接，并以 patch merging 形成层次金字塔。
models.core_mech_en: Alternates regular Windowed Multi-Head Self-Attention (W-MSA) with Shifted-Window Attention (SW-MSA) across a patch-merging multi-scale pyramid.
models.input_desc: 二维图像
models.input_en: 2D image (or 3D volume in Video/3D Swin)
models.output_desc: 四级层次化特征金字塔或任务预测
models.output_en: Four-stage multi-scale hierarchical feature pyramid or task predictions

models.title: DeiT
models.paper_title: Training Data-Efficient Image Transformers & Distillation through Attention
models.core_mech: 增加 distillation token 和专用 head，使 CNN teacher 信号通过 Transformer attention 注入 ViT。
models.core_mech_en: Augments ViT with a learnable distillation token that interacts with patch tokens via self-attention to distill inductive biases from a CNN teacher.
models.input_desc: ImageNet/医学 2D 图像与训练时 CNN teacher logits
models.input_en: 2D image (plus CNN teacher hard predictions during training)
models.output_desc: class token 与 distillation token 融合的分类预测
models.output_en: Fused class-token and distillation-token classification prediction

models.title: PVT
models.paper_title: Pyramid Vision Transformer: A Versatile Backbone for Dense Prediction without Convolutions
models.core_mech: 以逐级降低 token 分辨率的 Transformer pyramid 和 spatial-reduction attention 提供多尺度 dense-prediction backbone。
models.core_mech_en: Constructs a progressive four-stage token pyramid using Spatial-Reduction Attention (SRA) to compress K/V resolution before attention.
models.input_desc: 高分辨率 2D 图像
models.input_en: High-resolution 2D image
models.output_desc: 四级多尺度 Transformer 特征或分类/密集预测输出
models.output_en: Four-stage multi-scale feature pyramid (1/4 to 1/32 stride) for detection and segmentation

models.title: SimCLR
models.paper_title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
models.core_mech: 无动量教师或队列，以大 batch 内的两视图实例对和非线性投影头训练 NT-Xent。
models.core_mech_en: Trains an encoder and non-linear MLP projection head via in-batch NT-Xent contrastive loss across dual augmented views without momentum queues.
models.input_desc: 同一图像经两次随机增强得到的视图
models.input_en: Pair of randomly augmented views (x̃_i, x̃_j) of the same image
models.output_desc: 可迁移的图像 encoder 表征
models.output_en: Transferable visual representation h = f(x) (discarding projection head g after pretraining)

models.title: MoCo
models.paper_title: Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning
models.core_mech: 由 EMA key encoder 维护一致编码、由 FIFO queue 提供大规模跨 batch 负样本的对比字典。
models.core_mech_en: Decouples contrastive negative dictionary size from mini-batch size using a FIFO queue of encoded keys updated via a momentum (EMA) encoder.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的 query 与 key 增强视图
models.input_en: Query view x^q and key view x^k of the same image
models.output_desc: 对比预训练后的 query encoder 表征
models.output_en: Contrastively pretrained query encoder representation

models.title: MAE
models.paper_title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
models.core_mech: 高比例随机遮蔽后仅编码可见 patch，再用轻量 decoder 重建 mask patch 的非对称自编码器。
models.core_mech_en: Asymmetric autoencoder that masks 75% of image patches, encodes only the 25% visible tokens with a heavy ViT, and reconstructs pixels via a lightweight decoder.
models.input_desc: 随机遮蔽大比例 patch 的图像
models.input_en: Image with a high proportion (e.g., 75%) of randomly masked patches
models.output_desc: 重建的被遮蔽 patch 与预训练视觉 encoder
models.output_en: Reconstructed masked patches during pretraining; high-capacity ViT encoder for downstream fine-tuning

models.title: DINO
models.paper_title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
models.core_mech: 无负样本的 EMA teacher–student 跨视图概率匹配，以 centering 与 sharpening 防止塌缩。
models.core_mech_en: Negative-free self-distillation where a student ViT matches the centered, temperature-sharpened probability distribution of an EMA teacher across multi-crop views.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的多尺度全局与局部 crops
models.input_en: 2 global views and multiple local lower-resolution crops of an unlabeled image
models.output_desc: 无需标签的 ViT 图像与 patch 表征
models.output_en: Self-distilled ViT global [CLS] and dense patch representations

models.title: iBOT
models.paper_title: iBOT: Image BERT Pre-Training with Online Tokenizer
models.core_mech: EMA teacher 同时充当在线视觉 tokenizer，以图像级 DINO 蒸馏和被遮 patch token 蒸馏联合训练。
models.core_mech_en: Uses the EMA teacher simultaneously as an online visual tokenizer to jointly distill masked patch tokens alongside global [CLS] self-distillation.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的多裁剪视图与随机遮蔽 patch
models.input_en: Multi-crop augmented views with random block-wise patch masking applied to the student
models.output_desc: 同时具备全局语义和局部 patch 语义的视觉表征
models.output_en: ViT representations capturing both global image semantics and fine-grained local patch semantics

models.title: DINOv2
models.paper_title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
models.core_mech: 以 LVD-142M 数据策展配合 DINO+iBOT+KoLeo 复合自监督，并通过跨尺寸蒸馏形成模型家族。
models.core_mech_en: Combines automated deduplication/retrieval curation (LVD-142M) with a composite DINO + iBOT + KoLeo objective and multi-resolution distillation.
models.input_desc: 经自动去重、检索与平衡构建的大规模无标签图像池
models.input_en: Large-scale deduplicated and rebalanced unlabeled image corpus
models.output_desc: 跨域可迁移的全局与 patch 视觉特征
models.output_en: Out-of-the-box transferable frozen global and dense patch embeddings across model scales

models.title: BEiT
models.paper_title: BEiT: BERT Pre-Training of Image Transformers
models.core_mech: BEiT 的辨识点是预测外部 tokenizer 产生的离散视觉码，而非 MAE 式像素重建或普通对比学习。
models.core_mech_en: Pretrains Vision Transformers via BERT-style Masked Image Modeling by predicting discrete visual tokens generated by an external dVAE tokenizer.
models.input_desc: 原始图像，以及对其 patch 随机遮挡后的 token 序列
models.input_en: Raw image (for dVAE tokenizer) + block-wise masked patch sequence (for ViT encoder)
models.output_desc: 被遮挡位置的离散视觉 token 分布；微调时复用 Transformer 图像表示
models.output_en: Categorical distribution over discrete visual codes at masked positions; transferable ViT backbone

models.title: BYOL
models.paper_title: Bootstrap Your Own Latent: A New Approach to Self-Supervised Learning
models.core_mech: 没有负样本队列或聚类码本，核心稳定器是 stop-gradient、EMA 教师和仅在线侧存在的 predictor。
models.core_mech_en: Negative-free self-supervised representation learning stabilized by an asymmetric online predictor MLP, stop-gradient, and an EMA target encoder.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的两种随机增强视图
models.input_en: Two differently augmented views (v, v') of the same image
models.output_desc: 在线 encoder 的增强不变表示
models.output_en: Augmentation-invariant representation from the online encoder f_θ

models.title: SwAV
models.paper_title: Unsupervised Learning of Visual Features by Contrasting Cluster Assignments
models.core_mech: 以在线平衡原型分配作为跨视图预测目标，区别于 BYOL 的 EMA 表示回归和 SimCLR 的实例负样本。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces pairwise instance comparisons with online Sinkhorn-Knopp balanced prototype cluster assignment and swapped cross-view prediction.
models.input_desc: 同一图像的两张全局裁剪和若干局部裁剪
models.input_en: 2 global high-resolution views + M small local crops of the same image
models.output_desc: 可迁移图像表示与在线 prototype 分配
models.output_en: Transferable visual backbone and online learnable prototype codebook

models.title: Segment Anything (SAM)
models.paper_title: Segment Anything
models.core_mech: 可缓存的重型 image encoder、轻量 prompt encoder 与双向 attention mask decoder 解耦，并以动态 hypernetwork 输出多候选 mask。
models.core_mech_en: Decouples a heavy cacheable ViT image encoder from a lightweight spatial prompt encoder (points/boxes/masks) and an ambiguity-aware two-way attention mask decoder.
models.input_desc: 图像与点、框、粗 mask 或文本映射后的空间提示
models.input_en: 2D image + interactive spatial prompts (foreground/background points, bounding box, or coarse mask)
models.output_desc: 多个候选二值 mask 及其质量分数
models.output_en: Multiple candidate binary segmentation masks with predicted IoU quality scores

models.title: MedSAM
models.paper_title: Segment Anything in Medical Images
models.core_mech: 在 SAM 提示式架构上以大规模多模态医学分割监督做领域适配，并将 box prompt 作为稳定的目标定位接口。
models.core_mech_en: Adapts the promptable SAM architecture across 1.57 million medical image–mask pairs spanning 10 imaging modalities using bounding-box prompts.
models.input_desc: 标准化二维医学图像与目标边界框
models.input_en: Normalized 2D medical image slice + target anatomical/lesion bounding box prompt
models.output_desc: 边界框条件下的医学目标分割 mask
models.output_en: Box-conditioned binary segmentation mask for the target medical structure

models.title: SAM 2
models.paper_title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
models.core_mech: 在 SAM 提示式 decoder 外加入 memory attention、mask-conditioned memory encoder 和 object pointer，构成可交互的流式时序闭环。
models.core_mech_en: Extends promptable SAM with a streaming memory bank, memory cross-attention, mask-conditioned memory encoder, and occlusion score head across sequences.
models.input_desc: 图像或视频帧、当前帧提示及历史对象记忆
models.input_en: Video stream or 3D slice stack + spatial prompts (points/box/mask) on one or more reference frames
models.output_desc: 当前帧对象 mask，并更新供后续帧读取的记忆
models.output_en: Temporally/slice-propagated segmentation masks with updated object memory state

models.title: CLIP
models.paper_title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
models.core_mech: 完全分离的图像/文本双塔，通过批内 N×N 对称对比目标对齐，并用文本 prompt 充当开放词表分类器。
models.core_mech_en: Aligns separate image and text encoders in a shared embedding space via symmetric in-batch N×N contrastive loss, turning text prompts into zero-shot classifiers.
models.input_desc: 批量图像与自然语言文本配对
models.input_en: Mini-batch of N paired (image, natural-language caption) samples
models.output_desc: 共享嵌入空间中的图像/文本向量与零样本类别分数
models.output_en: L2-normalized shared-space image/text embeddings and cosine zero-shot classification logits

models.title: BLIP-2
models.paper_title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
models.core_mech: Q-Former 的 learnable queries 作为冻结图像 encoder 与冻结 LLM 之间唯一可训练的视觉信息瓶颈。
models.core_mech_en: Bridges a frozen pretrained image encoder to a frozen LLM using a lightweight Querying Transformer (Q-Former) with learnable query tokens as an information bottleneck.
models.input_desc: 图像与文本配对，生成阶段输入图像和文本 prompt
models.input_en: Image + text caption (Stage 1) or image + natural-language instruction prompt (Stage 2)
models.output_desc: 图像条件文本或视觉语言表征
models.output_en: Fixed-length visual query embeddings and autoregressive image-conditioned text generation

models.title: ConVIRT
models.paper_title: Contrastive Learning of Medical Visual Representations from Paired Images and Text
models.core_mech: 将自然生成的医学图像–报告对输入全局双塔，通过双向跨模态对比预训练医学视觉 encoder。
models.core_mech_en: Pretrains medical visual encoders directly from naturally occurring paired radiology images and free-text reports via bidirectional contrastive loss.
models.input_desc: 医学图像与配套自由文本报告
models.input_en: Paired medical image (e.g., chest X-ray) and corresponding clinical radiology report sentence
models.output_desc: 对齐的图像与报告全局表征
models.output_en: Contrastively aligned visual encoder representation for downstream low-label classification

models.title: GLoRIA
models.paper_title: GLoRIA: A Multimodal Global-Local Representation Learning Framework for Label-efficient Medical Image Recognition
models.core_mech: 在全局图文对比之外，以词为 query 对 CNN region grid 做软 attention 并训练局部区域–词对齐。
models.core_mech_en: Combines global image–report contrastive alignment with word-queried soft attention over local CNN image grid regions for fine-grained phrase grounding.
models.input_desc: 医学图像与对应放射报告
models.input_en: Medical image (chest X-ray) + paired free-text radiology report
models.output_desc: 全局图文对齐表征与局部区域–词语对齐特征
models.output_en: Globally aligned image/text embeddings + word-grounded local spatial attention maps

models.title: BioViL
models.paper_title: Making the Most of Text Semantics to Improve Biomedical Vision-Language Processing
models.core_mech: 以放射报告专用 CXR-BERT 提升文本语义，再联合学习检查级图文对比与短语–视觉 patch grounding。
models.core_mech_en: Pairs a radiology-specialized text encoder (CXR-BERT with RSM masked pretraining) with joint global and local patch–phrase contrastive alignment.
models.input_desc: 胸部 X-ray 与对应放射报告/短语
models.input_en: Chest radiograph + radiology report findings/impression text
models.output_desc: 具备报告语义与局部 grounding 能力的胸片表征
models.output_en: Negation- and clinical-syntax-aware visual-linguistic embeddings and local phrase grounding maps

models.title: BiomedCLIP
models.paper_title: BiomedCLIP: a multimodal biomedical foundation model pretrained from fifteen million scientific image-text pairs
models.core_mech: 以 PMC-15M 广域生物医学 figure–caption 语料、ViT 视觉塔和 PubMedBERT 文本塔训练领域 CLIP。
models.core_mech_en: Domain-specific CLIP trained on PMC-15M (15 million biomedical figure–caption pairs from PubMed Central) using a ViT vision tower and PubMedBERT text tower.
models.input_desc: 生物医学图像/论文图与对应 caption
models.input_en: Biomedical image (radiology, pathology, microscopy, chart) + scientific figure caption
models.output_desc: 开放词汇生物医学图文共享嵌入
models.output_en: Open-vocabulary biomedical multimodal embeddings for retrieval, zero-shot classification, and VQA

models.title: ALIGN
models.paper_title: Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision
models.core_mech: ALIGN 的主要贡献不是新交互模块，而是简单 EfficientNet/BERT 双塔在十亿级未精洗图文对上的规模化训练。
models.core_mech_en: Demonstrates that a simple EfficientNet + BERT dual encoder trained on over one billion noisy web image–alt-text pairs learns robust cross-modal representations.
models.input_desc: 网页图像与未经精细清洗的 alt-text 对
models.input_en: Web image + minimally filtered raw alt-text description
models.output_desc: 共享空间中的图像和文本 embedding，用于检索与零样本分类
models.output_en: Shared-space image and text embeddings for cross-modal retrieval and zero-shot classification

models.title: BLIP
models.paper_title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
models.core_mech: 区别于纯双塔，BLIP 用共享 MED 同时承担对齐、跨注意力匹配和因果生成，并把 captioner-filter 作为数据循环的一部分。
models.core_mech_en: Unifies vision–language understanding and generation via a Multimodal Mixture of Encoder–Decoder (MED) coupled with a CapFilt data bootstrapping loop.
models.input_desc: 图像、原始网页描述及由 captioner 生成的合成描述
models.input_en: Image + noisy web caption + synthetically generated and filtered captions
models.output_desc: 图文检索/匹配表示和自回归图像描述
models.output_en: Unimodal embeddings (ITC), cross-modal matching scores (ITM), and autoregressive captions (LM)

models.title: Florence-2
models.paper_title: Florence-2: Advancing a Unified Representation for a Variety of Vision Tasks
models.core_mech: 核心不是增加多个 head，而是用任务提示和位置 token 将 caption、检测、grounding、分割全部改写为 seq2seq。
models.core_mech_en: Reformulates captioning, object detection, phrase grounding, and segmentation into a single prompt-driven sequence-to-sequence generation task with quantized coordinate tokens.
models.input_desc: 图像与任务提示，例如 caption、detect、ground 或 segment
models.input_en: 2D image + task-specific text prompt (e.g., <OD>, <CAPTION>, <REFERRING_EXPRESSION_SEGMENTATION>)
models.output_desc: 文本、类别与量化位置 token 序列，后处理为描述、框或多边形
models.output_en: Unified token sequence decoding text descriptions, class labels, and quantized 0–999 bounding-box or polygon coordinates

models.title: MedCLIP
models.paper_title: MedCLIP: Contrastive Learning from Unpaired Medical Images and Text
models.core_mech: MedCLIP 的关键不是更深双塔，而是用医学知识构造任意图像—文本间的软语义配对。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces hard binary 1-to-1 image–report pairing with a soft semantic similarity matrix derived from clinical entity extraction, enabling unpaired contrastive learning.
models.input_desc: 可分别采样的胸片与报告句子，以及图像标签和文本实体
models.input_en: Independently sampled chest radiographs and clinical report sentences with extracted UMLS/CheXpert entities
models.output_desc: 医学图像/文本共享 embedding、零样本分类与检索相似度
models.output_en: Shared medical image–text embeddings and zero-shot disease probabilities

models.title: Med-Flamingo
models.paper_title: Med-Flamingo: a Multimodal Medical Few-shot Learner
models.core_mech: 区别于单一投影接 LLM，Med-Flamingo 用 Perceiver 固定视觉 latent，并在多层冻结 LLM 中反复注入门控跨注意力。
models.core_mech_en: Compresses variable-number medical images via a Perceiver Resampler and injects them into a frozen LLM through tanh-gated cross-attention layers for few-shot in-context learning.
models.input_desc: 交错的医学图像、文本及若干上下文示例
models.input_en: Interleaved sequence of exemplar medical images, clinical text, and a query medical image/question
models.output_desc: 条件于图像和 in-context 示例的自回归医学回答或解释
models.output_en: Autoregressive medical VQA answer or clinical rationale conditioned on in-context exemplars

models.title: LLaVA-Med
models.paper_title: LLaVA-Med: Training a Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for Biomedicine in One Day
models.core_mech: 其贡献主要是将 LLaVA 两阶段训练移到生物医学域：PMC 图注概念对齐后再做合成医学指令微调。
models.core_mech_en: Adapts the LLaVA visual-instruction-tuning paradigm to biomedicine via two-stage training: PMC figure–caption alignment followed by GPT-4-synthesized biomedical instruction tuning.
models.input_desc: 生物医学图像、图注或用户指令/问题
models.input_en: Biomedical image + user clinical question or conversational instruction
models.output_desc: 面向图像的自回归回答、描述与解释文本
models.output_en: Open-ended autoregressive biomedical explanation, visual QA response, or figure analysis

models.title: RadFM
models.paper_title: Towards Generalist Foundation Model for Radiology by Leveraging Web-scale 2D&3D Medical Data
models.core_mech: RadFM 的模型特异性在于统一 2D/3D 视觉 encoder 与 Perceiver 扫描聚合，再接生成式 LLM。
models.core_mech_en: Unifies 2D radiographs and 3D volumetric scans (CT/MRI) via a 2D/3D ViT + Perceiver 3D aggregator feeding into a generative radiology LLM.
models.input_desc: 一张或一组 2D 图像、3D CT/MRI 体积及文本指令
models.input_en: Single/multiple 2D radiographs or 3D CT/MRI volumes + natural-language clinical instruction
models.output_desc: 放射学自由文本回答、报告或识别结果
models.output_en: Free-text radiology report, VQA answer, abnormality diagnosis, or rationale

models.title: MAIRA-1
models.paper_title: MAIRA-1: A Specialised Large Multimodal Model for Radiology Report Generation
models.core_mech: MAIRA-1 不是通用图文预训练模型，而是冻结胸片 RAD-DINO、使用四层 adapter，并完整微调 Vicuna-7B 的专用报告生成器。
models.core_mech_en: Specialist chest X-ray report generator pairing a frozen CXR-specific RAD-DINO visual encoder, a 4-layer MLP adapter, and a fully fine-tuned Vicuna-7B LLM.
models.input_desc: 胸部 X 光图像及可选 indication 文本
models.input_en: Frontal chest X-ray + clinical indication/history prompt
models.output_desc: 放射报告 Findings 文本
models.output_en: Structured clinical radiology Findings narrative

models.title: MAIRA-2
models.paper_title: MAIRA-2: Grounded Radiology Report Generation
models.core_mech: 相较 MAIRA-1，MAIRA-2 增加多视图/既往/报告上下文，并把报告句子与生成式 bounding-box token 绑定。
models.core_mech_en: Extends MAIRA-1 with multi-view (AP/PA + lateral), prior study/report longitudinal context, and interleaved quantized bounding-box tokens for grounded reporting.
models.input_desc: 当前正位/侧位胸片、既往正位胸片与报告、indication、technique、comparison 和任务提示
models.input_en: Current frontal & lateral CXR, prior CXR, prior report, indication, technique, comparison + task prompt
models.output_desc: 普通 Findings、逐句关联边界框的 grounded Findings，或短语定位框
models.output_en: Ungrounded Findings, spatially grounded Findings (linking each clinical sentence to bounding boxes), or phrase grounding

models.title: BiomedGPT
models.paper_title: A Generalist Vision-Language Foundation Model for Diverse Biomedical Tasks
models.core_mech: BiomedGPT 以模态无关、任务无关的 encoder—decoder token 化接口统一生物医学视觉、语言和多模态输出。
models.core_mech_en: Modality- and task-agnostic encoder–decoder Transformer unifying biomedical images, clinical text, and bounding boxes into a discrete token sequence interface.
models.input_desc: 文本 token、2D 图像 patch/token 及任务指令
models.input_en: 2D biomedical image patches, text tokens, and task-specifying instruction prompt
models.output_desc: 文本、类别、坐标或图像 token 等统一序列输出
models.output_en: Unified autoregressive token stream representing free text, classification labels, or spatial coordinates

models.title: UNI
models.paper_title: Towards a General-Purpose Foundation Model for Computational Pathology
models.core_mech: 在超过一亿病理图块上以 DINOv2 式 teacher–student 训练 ViT-L/16，向多类病理任务提供统一冻结 tile encoder。
models.core_mech_en: ViT-L/16 tile encoder pretrained via DINOv2 self-distillation and iBOT masked patch modeling on over 100 million H&E histopathology patches (Mass-100K).
models.input_desc: 全视野病理切片切出的无标签组织图块
models.input_en: 256×256 H&E histopathology tissue tiles extracted from whole-slide images (WSIs)
models.output_desc: 可冻结迁移的病理图块表征及其下游切片级聚合
models.output_en: Frozen transferable tile embeddings for ROI tasks or MIL whole-slide aggregation

models.title: CONCH
models.paper_title: A Visual-Language Foundation Model for Computational Pathology
models.core_mech: 在病理领域把 CLIP 式全局对比与 CoCa 式图像条件 caption decoder 联合训练，同时服务判别与生成。
models.core_mech_en: CoCa-style computational pathology vision–language foundation model jointly trained with contrastive image–text alignment and generative caption decoding on 1.17M pairs.
models.input_desc: 组织病理图像与人工生成的病理文本描述
models.input_en: Histopathology image tile/ROI + paired pathology text description or prompt
models.output_desc: 病理图文共享表征及图像条件文本生成
models.output_en: Shared multimodal retrieval/zero-shot embeddings + autoregressive pathology caption/text generation

models.title: Prov-GigaPath
models.paper_title: A Whole-Slide Foundation Model for Digital Pathology from Real-World Data
models.core_mech: DINOv2 病理 tile encoder 与 LongNet 膨胀注意力 slide encoder 两级串联，并以 masked tile reconstruction 预训练全切片上下文。
models.core_mech_en: Two-stage gigapixel pathology foundation model pairing a DINOv2 tile encoder with a LongNet dilated-attention whole-slide encoder pretrained via masked tile reconstruction.
models.input_desc: 全视野病理切片及其组织 tile 坐标序列
models.input_en: Whole-slide image (WSI) decomposed into tens of thousands of tissue tiles with 2D spatial (x, y) coordinates
models.output_desc: 整张 WSI 的长上下文表征与病例级任务预测
models.output_en: Contextualized whole-slide representation and patient/case-level diagnostic or genomic predictions

models.title: Virchow
models.paper_title: A Foundation Model for Clinical-Grade Computational Pathology and Rare Cancers Detection
models.core_mech: Virchow 是 632M ViT-H/14 的病理 tile foundation encoder，以约 150 万临床 WSI 的 DINOv2 自监督规模取胜。
models.core_mech_en: 632M-parameter ViT-H/14 computational pathology tile foundation model pretrained with DINOv2 on 2 billion tiles from 1.5 million clinical H&E whole-slide images.
models.input_desc: H&E 全切片切出的组织 tile 及其全局/局部增强视图
models.input_en: 224×224 H&E histopathology tissue tile (with global and local crops during pretraining)
models.output_desc: tile-level 632M ViT embedding；下游可经 WSI aggregator 形成病例预测
models.output_en: 2560-D tile representation ([CLS] concatenated with mean patch token) feeding downstream WSI aggregators

models.title: CHIEF
models.paper_title: A Pathology Foundation Model for Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis Prediction
models.core_mech: CHIEF 明确串联 CTransPath tile 自监督和带解剖条件的 WSI attention 弱监督，而非只发布局部 patch encoder。
models.core_mech_en: Couples self-supervised tile encoding (CTransPath) with anatomical-site-conditioned whole-slide attention aggregation trained across 60,530 WSIs.
models.input_desc: H&E WSI、tile 特征及训练时的癌症/解剖部位弱标签
models.input_en: H&E whole-slide image tiles + anatomical primary site text/categorical embedding
models.output_desc: 通用 tile embedding、WSI embedding 和诊断/预后任务输出
models.output_en: Slide-level diagnostic representation for cancer detection, tumor origin, genomic mutation, and survival prediction

models.title: TITAN
models.paper_title: A Multimodal Whole-Slide Foundation Model for Pathology
models.core_mech: TITAN 的特异性是三阶段 whole-slide 预训练：特征网格 iBOT、ROI caption CoCa、WSI report CoCa。
models.core_mech_en: Three-stage multimodal whole-slide foundation model pretrained via iBOT on 2D tile feature grids, CoCa on synthetic ROI captions, and CoCa on whole-slide pathology reports.
models.input_desc: 预提取病理 patch 网格、ROI 合成描述和 WSI 病理报告
models.input_en: Pre-extracted 2D spatial grid of WSI patch embeddings (CONCH v1.5) + ROI descriptions / clinical pathology reports
models.output_desc: 通用 whole-slide embedding、跨模态检索分数与病理文本生成
models.output_en: General-purpose whole-slide embedding, zero-shot slide classification, cross-modal report retrieval, and slide report generation

models.title: PRISM2
models.paper_title: End-to-End Multimodal Pathology Foundation Model with Clinical Dialogue
models.core_mech: PRISM2 明确提供双嵌入：Perceiver 的通用 base embedding，以及 Phi-3 隐状态导出的诊断 embedding。
models.core_mech_en: Pairs a Perceiver slide encoder over Virchow2 tile embeddings with a Phi-3 LLM trained on single-turn clinical dialogues derived from pathology reports, exposing dual embeddings.
models.input_desc: 一个病例的一张或多张 H&E WSI、文本提示与由报告改写的单轮临床对话
models.input_en: Multi-slide H&E case tile embeddings (Virchow2) + clinical prompt / diagnostic query
models.output_desc: 2560 维 base embedding、3072 维 diagnostic embedding、报告或问答文本
models.output_en: 2560-D base slide embedding, 3072-D LLM diagnostic embedding, or autoregressive pathology text response

models.title: Merlin
models.paper_title: Merlin: a Computed Tomography Vision-Language Foundation Model and Dataset
models.core_mech: 以 I3D ResNet-152 原生编码完整 CT，并用 EHR phenotype prediction 与 Clinical Longformer 报告对比进行多源多任务预训练。
models.core_mech_en: Native 3D abdominal CT foundation model encoding whole volumes with an I3D ResNet-152 supervised jointly by EHR diagnosis codes (phenotypes) and radiology reports.
models.input_desc: 三维 CT 体积、同检查放射报告与 EHR diagnosis codes
models.input_en: Volumetric 3D abdominal CT scan + paired free-text radiology report + longitudinal EHR ICD diagnosis codes
models.output_desc: 检查级 3D 视觉语言表征及零样本/适配后临床任务输出
models.output_en: Study-level 3D visual-linguistic representation supporting zero-shot findings, EHR phenotype prediction, and 3D segmentation

models.title: BME-X
models.paper_title: A Foundation Model for Enhancing Magnetic Resonance Images and Downstream Segmentation, Registration and Diagnostic Tasks
models.core_mech: BME-X 不是通用 MRI encoder，而是先预测组织标签、再用组织感知 DU-Net 生成增强图像的两阶段恢复模型。
models.core_mech_en: Two-stage brain MRI enhancement foundation model that first estimates tissue probability maps and then conditions a Dual U-Net (DU-Net) to restore harmonized images.
models.input_desc: 受运动、低分辨率、噪声、扫描仪或场强差异影响的结构脑 MRI
models.input_en: Structural brain MRI degraded by motion, low resolution, noise, or cross-scanner field-strength shifts
models.output_desc: 高质量、组织强度更一致的增强 MRI，可供分割、配准与诊断
models.output_en: Harmonized, artifact-corrected, high-resolution brain MRI ready for downstream morphometry, registration, and diagnosis

models.title: Prima
models.paper_title: Learning Neuroimaging Models from Health System-Scale Data
models.core_mech: Prima 的核心链路是 32×32×4 子体积 VQ-VAE token、sequence ViT、study ViT，再以神经放射报告做 CLIP 对齐。
models.core_mech_en: Hierarchical clinical brain MRI study foundation model chaining 32×32×4 sub-volume VQ-VAE tokenization, a sequence-level ViT, and a study-level ViT aligned with radiology reports.
models.input_desc: 一个真实脑 MRI study 中的多序列 3D 体积、序列名称/描述与配对报告
models.input_en: Complete clinical brain MRI study (multiple heterogeneous 3D sequences + sequence metadata) + paired neuroradiology report
models.output_desc: 完整检查级 embedding、零样本相似度及冻结特征上的 52 任务 MLP 预测
models.output_en: Study-level multimodal embedding supporting zero-shot retrieval and 52 neurological diagnostic/triage MLP probes

models.title: MARS
models.paper_title: Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Pretraining for Generalizable MRI Analysis in Versatile Clinical Applications
models.core_mech: MARS 用 3D Swin 加结构/序列双支路、元数据与对比约束，并通过重建/合成把 anatomy-invariant 与 sequence-specific 信息解耦。
models.core_mech_en: Multi-sequence 3D MRI foundation model pairing a 3D Swin backbone with dual structure/sequence branches and acquisition metadata to disentangle anatomy from contrast.
models.input_desc: 跨 10 个解剖区、多 MRI 序列的 3D volume 及其遮挡/跨序列变体
models.input_en: Multi-sequence 3D MRI volumes across 10 anatomical regions with sequence metadata and cross-sequence masking
models.output_desc: 可迁移 3D Swin 表示，以及供分割、分类、配准、预测和报告任务使用的权重
models.output_en: Disentangled anatomical and sequence representations transferable across 44 segmentation, classification, registration, and report tasks

models.title: Decipher-MR
models.paper_title: Decipher-MR: A Vision-Language Foundation Model for 3D MRI Representations
models.core_mech: Decipher-MR 明确采用 8³ patch 的 3D ViT-Base、DINOv2/iBOT 视觉预训练、PubMedBERT MLM，再做器官感知的 MRI-report CLIP 对齐。
models.core_mech_en: 3D MRI vision–language foundation model combining an 8³-patch 3D ViT-Base (pretrained via 3D DINOv2/iBOT) with PubMedBERT MLM and organ-aware MRI–report CLIP alignment.
models.input_desc: 单个 3D MRI series 与同 study 的器官级报告文本
models.input_en: 3D MRI series volume + paired study-level organ-parsed radiology report text
models.output_desc: 512 维共享 MRI—文本 embedding、冻结视觉特征及轻量下游 decoder 输出
models.output_en: 512-D shared 3D MRI–text embedding and frozen 3D visual features for lightweight downstream decoders

models.title: Deep Autoencoder
models.paper_title: Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks
models.core_mech: 逐层 RBM 生成式预训练初始化深层对称 encoder–decoder，再以全局重建误差微调非线性 bottleneck。
models.core_mech_en: Layer-by-layer Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) generative pretraining initializing a deep symmetric encoder–decoder fine-tuned via global reconstruction error.
models.input_desc: 高维数据向量或展平图像
models.input_en: High-dimensional input vector or flattened image patch
models.output_desc: 低维 bottleneck 表征与输入重建
models.output_en: Low-dimensional non-linear bottleneck code z and reconstructed input x̂

models.title: GAN
models.paper_title: Generative Adversarial Nets
models.core_mech: 生成器与判别器通过同一 value function 对抗优化，以数据驱动判别器替代固定重建损失。
models.core_mech_en: Generator and discriminator networks engage in a two-player minimax game, replacing hand-crafted pixel reconstruction losses with a learned adversarial critic.
models.input_desc: 先验噪声 z 与真实数据样本 x
models.input_en: Latent noise vector z ~ p_z(z) and real data samples x ~ p_data(x)
models.output_desc: 逼近真实数据分布的生成样本
models.output_en: Synthesized samples G(z) approximating the real data distribution

models.title: pix2pix
models.paper_title: Image-to-Image Translation with Conditional Adversarial Networks
models.core_mech: 以 U-Net 生成器保持逐像素空间对应，70×70 conditional PatchGAN 学局部真实感，并用配对 L1 锚定结构。
models.core_mech_en: Pairs a U-Net generator (preserving pixel-level spatial alignment) with a 70×70 conditional PatchGAN discriminator and paired L1 structural anchoring.
models.input_desc: 空间配准的成对源域图像 x 与目标域图像 y
models.input_en: Spatially co-registered paired source image x and target ground-truth image y
models.output_desc: 与 x 对齐的目标域预测 G(x)
models.output_en: Spatially aligned translated target-domain image G(x)

models.title: CycleGAN
models.paper_title: Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation using Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks
models.core_mech: 双生成器、双 PatchGAN 与 X→Y→X / Y→X→Y 两个 cycle L1 闭环，使不成对域转换可训练。
models.core_mech_en: Couples dual generators (G: X→Y, F: Y→X) and dual PatchGAN discriminators with forward and backward L1 cycle-consistency loops for unpaired translation.
models.input_desc: 两组不成对的域 X 与域 Y 图像
models.input_en: Two unpaired collections of images from source domain X and target domain Y
models.output_desc: X→Y 与 Y→X 两个方向的域转换图像
models.output_en: Bi-directional domain-translated images G(x) ∈ Y and F(y) ∈ X

models.title: DDPM
models.paper_title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
models.core_mech: 预设离散高斯前向链，加训练稳定的 epsilon/score 网络，再按学习到的随机逆链逐步采样。
models.core_mech_en: Defines a fixed discrete Markov Gaussian forward noising chain and trains a noise-prediction U-Net (ε_θ) across all noise scales for iterative reverse sampling.
models.input_desc: 训练时的干净样本 x0；生成时的高斯噪声 xT
models.input_en: Clean training image x_0 (during training); pure Gaussian noise x_T ~ N(0,I) (during sampling)
models.output_desc: 经 T 步随机逆扩散得到的样本 x0_hat
models.output_en: Sample x̂_0 synthesized via T iterative stochastic reverse denoising steps

models.title: DDIM
models.paper_title: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
models.core_mech: 在相同 DDPM 训练边缘下采用隐式非 Markov、可确定性的跳步轨迹。
models.core_mech_en: Constructs non-Markovian, deterministic reverse sampling trajectories that share the exact same marginal training distributions as DDPM.
models.input_desc: 与 DDPM 相同目标训练的 epsilon 网络和初始噪声 xT
models.input_en: Pretrained DDPM noise-prediction network ε_θ and initial Gaussian noise x_T
models.output_desc: 少步确定性或可控随机性的生成样本 x0_hat
models.output_en: Sample x̂_0 generated in 10–50 deterministic (or tunable-stochasticity) subsequence steps

models.title: Score-SDE
models.paper_title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
models.core_mech: 以连续 score field 同时定义 reverse-time SDE、predictor-corrector sampler 与同边缘的 probability-flow ODE。
models.core_mech_en: Unifies discrete diffusion and score matching into a continuous-time Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) with a corresponding deterministic Probability-Flow ODE.
models.input_desc: 数据样本 x(0)；生成时的先验噪声 x(T)
models.input_en: Continuous data sample x(0); prior noise distribution x(T) at terminal time T
models.output_desc: 经 reverse SDE 或 probability-flow ODE 得到的样本
models.output_en: Samples generated via Predictor-Corrector reverse SDE or exact likelihoods via Probability-Flow ODE

models.title: Latent Diffusion
models.paper_title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
models.core_mech: 先以 autoencoder 压缩图像，再在 latent grid 上运行可 cross-attention 条件化的 diffusion。
models.core_mech_en: Perceptually compresses high-resolution images into a lower-dimensional spatial latent grid via a VQ/KL autoencoder before running cross-attention-conditioned diffusion.
models.input_desc: 图像 x 与可选条件 c；生成时为 latent 高斯噪声 zT
models.input_en: High-resolution image x (encoded to z_0 = E(x)) + optional multimodal conditioning c (text, mask, layout)
models.output_desc: 由解码器还原的高分辨率图像 x_hat
models.output_en: High-resolution synthesized image x̂ = D(ẑ_0) decoded from denoised latent grid

models.title: DDRM
models.paper_title: Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models
models.core_mech: 在退化算子 SVD 基中把预训练 diffusion prior 与线性观测条件分量逐时间步耦合。
models.core_mech_en: Couples an unconditional pretrained diffusion prior with a linear forward operator y = Hx + z by running conditional reverse diffusion in the SVD spectral domain of H.
models.input_desc: 线性退化测量 y=A x+n、已知 A 及预训练无条件 diffusion prior
models.input_en: Linearly degraded measurement y = Hx + z, known SVD of operator H, and an unconditional pretrained diffusion model
models.output_desc: 满足线性测量约束的恢复样本 x_hat
models.output_en: Restored image x̂ consistent with both linear measurements y and the pretrained diffusion prior

models.title: DPS
models.paper_title: Diffusion Posterior Sampling for General Noisy Inverse Problems
models.core_mech: 在每个 diffusion 逆时间步，把预训练先验 score 与经 x0 估计反传的测量 likelihood gradient 相加。
models.core_mech_en: Approximates intractable time-dependent measurement likelihood scores ∇_{x_t} log p_t(y|x_t) via backpropagation through the Tweedie posterior mean estimate x̂_0(x_t).
models.input_desc: 噪声测量 y、可微前向模型 A 与预训练 diffusion score prior
models.input_en: Corrupted measurement y, general differentiable forward operator A(·), and pretrained unconditional score network s_θ
models.output_desc: 近似后验样本 x_hat ~ p(x|y)
models.output_en: Posterior sample x̂ ~ p(x|y) satisfying noisy linear or non-linear measurement constraints

models.title: DiffusionMBIR
models.paper_title: Solving 3D Inverse Problems using Pre-trained 2D Diffusion Models
models.core_mech: 把预训练 2D diffusion slice prior 嵌入 3D MBIR/data-consistency 外循环，并显式加跨切片约束。
models.core_mech_en: Embeds a pretrained 2D slice diffusion score prior into an alternating 3D Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction (MBIR) loop with explicit z-axis total variation regularization.
models.input_desc: 3D 测量 y、体成像算子 A/A* 与预训练 2D diffusion prior
models.input_en: 3D tomographic measurements y, 3D forward/adjoint operators A/A*, and a pretrained 2D axial diffusion model
models.output_desc: 数据一致且具跨切片约束的 3D 体 x_hat
models.output_en: Volumetric 3D reconstruction x̂ maintaining 3D measurement fidelity and inter-slice smoothness

models.title: Flow Matching
models.paper_title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
models.core_mech: 在已知 probability path 上回归 velocity（而非 score），再直接积分神经 ODE 完成分布运输。
models.core_mech_en: Trains continuous normalizing flows without ODE simulation by directly regressing the marginal vector field u_t(x) along conditional probability paths.
models.input_desc: 源分布样本 x0（通常高斯噪声）与数据样本 x1
models.input_en: Source prior sample x_0 ~ p_0 and target data sample x_1 ~ p_1 interpolated along a conditional path x_t
models.output_desc: 沿学习 ODE 从源分布运输得到的生成样本
models.output_en: Samples generated by integrating the learned velocity field dx/dt = v_θ(x_t, t) from t=0 to t=1

models.title: Rectified Flow
models.paper_title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
models.core_mech: 以直线端点路径训练 velocity，并通过 reflow 重新耦合端点以进一步拉直 ODE 轨迹。
models.core_mech_en: Learns an ODE velocity field along straight linear interpolations x_t = (1−t)x_0 + t x_1 and iteratively straightens trajectories via reflow recoupling.
models.input_desc: 源噪声 z0 与目标数据 x1 的 coupling
models.input_en: Coupled pairs (x_0, x_1) from source distribution π_0 and target distribution π_1
models.output_desc: 沿近直线 ODE 少步运输得到的样本 x_hat
models.output_en: Nearly straight-line ODE transport trajectories enabling high-fidelity 1-to-few-step Euler generation

models.title: Consistency Models
models.paper_title: Consistency Models
models.core_mech: 学习沿 PF-ODE 轨迹不变的 endpoint map，使任意噪声尺度可直接一步映射到 clean sample。
models.core_mech_en: Learns a self-consistent function f_θ(x_t, t) = x_ε that maps any point along a Probability-Flow ODE trajectory directly to its clean origin in a single step.
models.input_desc: 噪声状态 x_t；蒸馏模式下还需预训练 diffusion score teacher
models.input_en: Noisy state x_t along a PF-ODE trajectory (distilled from a pretrained score model or trained standalone)
models.output_desc: 一次或少数几次函数调用得到的 clean sample
models.output_en: One-step or few-step clean sample estimate x̂_0

models.title: DiT
models.paper_title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
models.core_mech: 把 noisy latent patch 化，以 adaLN-Zero 条件化的 Transformer blocks 作为 diffusion score/velocity backbone。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces the convolutional U-Net backbone in Latent Diffusion with an isotropic Vision Transformer over latent patches conditioned via Adaptive LayerNorm-Zero (adaLN-Zero).
models.input_desc: 加噪 latent 图像 z_t、时间 t 与可选类别/条件 c
models.input_en: Noisy latent tensor z_t, diffusion timestep t, and conditioning embedding c
models.output_desc: epsilon/score 参数与可选方差预测，经逆扩散得到并解码的图像
models.output_en: Predicted noise ε_θ, diagonal covariance Σ_θ, or velocity v_θ on the latent token grid

models.title: DDNM
models.paper_title: Zero-Shot Image Restoration Using Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Model
models.core_mech: DDNM 用 A†y 固定 range-space 信息，只让 diffusion denoiser 生成 null-space 分量。
models.core_mech_en: Decomposes reverse diffusion intermediate estimates x̂_{0|t} via the Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse A† into a fixed measurement range-space component A†y and a generated null-space component (I − A†A)x̂_{0|t}.
models.input_desc: 线性退化测量 y=Ax+n、已知 A 及伪逆 A†、预训练无条件扩散模型
models.input_en: Linear measurement y = Ax + n, known operator A with pseudoinverse A†, and a pretrained unconditional diffusion model
models.output_desc: 满足或近似满足测量约束的恢复图像样本
models.output_en: Zero-shot restored image satisfying A x̂ = y while filling null-space details via the diffusion prior

models.title: RealNVP
models.paper_title: Density Estimation Using Real NVP
models.core_mech: RealNVP 以三角 Jacobian 的 affine coupling 获得同时精确可逆、可采样且可算 log-likelihood 的映射。
models.core_mech_en: Constructs an exactly invertible normalizing flow using stacked affine coupling layers whose triangular Jacobians permit O(D) log-determinant and exact likelihood evaluation.
models.input_desc: 连续化图像 x
models.input_en: Continuous-valued image or feature vector x
models.output_desc: 潜变量 z、精确 log-likelihood，或由 z 反演生成的图像
models.output_en: Latent variable z = f(x), exact log-density log p_X(x), or exact inverse sample x = f^{-1}(z)

models.title: Glow
models.paper_title: Glow: Generative Flow with Invertible 1×1 Convolutions
models.core_mech: Glow 在 RealNVP coupling 上加入数据依赖 ActNorm 和可学习可逆 1×1 通道卷积。
models.core_mech_en: Enhances multi-scale affine coupling flows with activation normalization (ActNorm) and learnable invertible 1×1 channel convolutions parameterized via LU decomposition.
models.input_desc: 连续化图像
models.input_en: Continuous-valued image x
models.output_desc: 精确似然和层级潜变量，或由潜变量反演的生成图像
models.output_en: Hierarchical latent variables z, exact log-likelihood log p(x), and exact latent-to-image synthesis

models.title: PFGM++
models.paper_title: PFGM++: Unlocking the Potential of Physics-Inspired Generative Models
models.core_mech: PFGM++ 用可调增广维度 D 的 Poisson 电场统一 PFGM 与 diffusion，而不是固定高斯前向噪声过程。
models.core_mech_en: Embeds N-dimensional data on the z=0 hyperplane of an N+D augmented space and learns the high-dimensional Poisson electric field lines, unifying PFGM (D=1) and Diffusion (D→∞).
models.input_desc: 训练数据 x∈R^N；采样时为 N+D 维简单先验状态
models.input_en: Training data x ∈ R^N embedded in R^{N+D}; hemispherical prior samples at large radius r_max during generation
models.output_desc: 沿学习电场 ODE 流回数据超平面的生成样本
models.output_en: Samples generated by integrating the learned augmented electric field ODE back to the z=0 hyperplane

models.title: SiT
models.paper_title: SiT: Exploring Flow and Diffusion-Based Generative Models with Scalable Interpolant Transformers
models.core_mech: SiT 将 DiT 放入 stochastic interpolant 框架，用统一模型显式比较 velocity、score 和 diffusion 参数化。
models.core_mech_en: Places the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone inside a continuous-time Stochastic Interpolant framework to systematically decouple interpolation schedules, model targets, and samplers.
models.input_desc: 数据样本 x0、噪声 ε、连续时间 t 和可选类别条件
models.input_en: Data sample x_0 (or latent), Gaussian noise ε, continuous time t ∈ [0,1], and conditioning label c
models.output_desc: 学习到的 velocity/score/noise 场及 ODE/SDE 生成样本
models.output_en: Samples generated via configurable deterministic ODE or stochastic SDE integrators from the same SiT backbone

models.title: FBPConvNet
models.paper_title: Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Inverse Problems in Imaging
models.core_mech: 解析 FBP 与单次残差 U-Net 串联，而非端到端替代投影算子或进行 unrolled data consistency。
models.core_mech_en: Cascades analytical Filtered Backprojection (FBP) with a multi-scale residual U-Net in the image domain to remove sparse-view streaking artifacts.
models.input_desc: 稀疏视角 CT 投影 y（sinogram）与已知扫描几何
models.input_en: Sparse-view CT sinogram measurements y with known acquisition geometry
models.output_desc: 伪影抑制后的 CT 图像 x_hat
models.output_en: Artifact-suppressed CT image x̂ = x_FBP + R_θ(x_FBP)

models.title: Learned Primal-Dual
models.paper_title: Learned Primal-Dual Reconstruction
models.core_mech: 同时学习 measurement-domain dual 与 image-domain primal 更新，并在每个 unrolled stage 显式调用 A 和 A*。
models.core_mech_en: Unrolls primal–dual proximal optimization into K stages of paired measurement-domain (dual) and image-domain (primal) residual CNNs calling A and A* at every stage.
models.input_desc: 测量 y、前向算子 A 与伴随算子 A*
models.input_en: Raw tomographic measurements y, forward projection operator A, and adjoint backprojection operator A*
models.output_desc: K 级展开后的图像域 primal 重建 x_hat
models.output_en: Reconstructed image x^{(K)} after K unrolled primal–dual iterations

models.title: Variational Network
models.paper_title: Learning a Variational Network for Reconstruction of Accelerated MRI Data
models.core_mech: 把多线圈 MRI 的变分梯度下降展开，并联合学习卷积滤波器、势函数与每级更新权重。
models.core_mech_en: Unrolls K steps of gradient descent on a generalized Fields-of-Experts variational energy for multi-coil MRI, jointly learning convolutional filters, non-linear potentials, and data weights.
models.input_desc: 欠采样多线圈 k-space y、采样掩膜 P 与线圈灵敏度 S
models.input_en: Undersampled multi-coil k-space data y, sampling mask P, and pre-estimated coil sensitivity maps S
models.output_desc: K 次变分更新后的复数 MRI 图像 x_hat
models.output_en: Complex-valued reconstructed MRI image x^{(K)} after K unrolled variational steps

models.title: MoDL
models.paper_title: MoDL: Model-Based Deep Learning Architecture for Inverse Problems
models.core_mech: 共享 CNN prior 与可微共轭梯度 data-consistency 子问题交替展开。
models.core_mech_en: Alternates a weight-shared multi-layer CNN denoiser prior D_θ with a differentiable numerical Conjugate Gradient (CG) solver enforcing exact data consistency (A*A + λI)^{-1}.
models.input_desc: 测量 y、已知前向算子 A 与伴随 A*
models.input_en: Undersampled multi-coil k-space measurements b, forward operator A (incorporating coil maps + FFT + mask), and adjoint A*
models.output_desc: K 次共享权重迭代后的重建 x_hat
models.output_en: Reconstructed MRI image x_K after K weight-shared alternating minimization stages

models.title: VarNet
models.paper_title: End-to-End Variational Networks for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction
models.core_mech: 灵敏度估计网络加多级 k-space variational cascades，将图像正则与采样点 DC 工程化为统一流程。
models.core_mech_en: End-to-End Variational Network combining a joint U-Net coil sensitivity estimation module (SME) with K k-space variational cascades using U-Net image regularizers.
models.input_desc: 欠采样多线圈 k-space y 与采样掩膜 M
models.input_en: Raw undersampled multi-coil k-space y and Cartesian undersampling mask M (including auto-calibration lines)
models.output_desc: 灵敏度组合后的 MRI 幅度图 x_hat
models.output_en: Root-sum-of-squares or coil-combined MRI magnitude image x̂

models.title: AUTOMAP
models.paper_title: Image Reconstruction by Domain-Transform Manifold Learning
models.core_mech: AUTOMAP 的标志是大规模全连接层直接承担 domain transform，而非先做 FBP/IFFT 再用 CNN 后处理。
models.core_mech_en: Learns the sensor-to-image domain transform directly via large fully connected layers mapping flattened raw measurements to an image grid followed by sparse convolutional refinement.
models.input_desc: MRI k-space、CT 投影等序列化测量向量
models.input_en: Flattened raw sensor measurement vector (e.g., k-space samples or Radon projections)
models.output_desc: 重建图像
models.output_en: Reconstructed spatial-domain image

models.title: LEARN
models.paper_title: LEARN: Learned Experts' Assessment-Based Reconstruction Network for Sparse-Data CT
models.core_mech: LEARN 每个展开阶段并行计算 CT 数据梯度和 learned experts CNN 正则梯度，再做残差更新。
models.core_mech_en: Unrolls K iterative sparse-view CT reconstruction stages where each stage combines an explicit projection residual gradient A^T(Ax^t − y) with a stage-specific 3-layer CNN regularizer.
models.input_desc: 稀疏视角 CT 投影 y、系统矩阵 A/Aᵀ 和初始图像 x0
models.input_en: Sparse-view CT sinogram y, system projection matrix A / backprojection A^T, and initial image x^0
models.output_desc: 固定阶段后的 CT 重建 xN
models.output_en: Reconstructed CT image x^K after K≈50 unrolled expert stages

models.title: DnCNN
models.paper_title: Beyond a Gaussian Denoiser: Residual Learning of Deep CNN for Image Denoising
models.core_mech: 深 CNN 回归噪声残差，再与输入显式相减，而非直接回归 clean image。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a deep plain CNN with BatchNorm and ReLU to regress the additive noise residual R_θ(y) ≈ n rather than the clean image, recovering x̂ = y − R_θ(y).
models.input_desc: 含噪图像 y=x+n
models.input_en: Noisy observation y = x + n
models.output_desc: 去噪图像 x_hat=y-R_theta(y)
models.output_en: Denoised image estimate x̂ = y − R_θ(y)

models.title: Noise2Noise
models.paper_title: Noise2Noise: Learning Image Restoration without Clean Data
models.core_mech: 使用同一信号的两次独立无偏噪声实现进行 noisy-to-noisy 监督，训练阶段不需要干净靶图。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a denoising network using pairs of independent noisy realizations (y_1, y_2) of the same underlying anatomy without ever observing clean ground truth.
models.input_desc: 同一潜在图像 x 的两次独立含噪观测 y1、y2
models.input_en: Two independent noisy observations (y_1, y_2) of the exact same underlying clean signal x
models.output_desc: 以单次含噪观测为输入的条件均值估计 x_hat
models.output_en: Clean conditional expectation estimate x̂ = f_θ(y_1)

models.title: Noise2Self
models.paper_title: Noise2Self: Blind Denoising by Self-Supervision
models.core_mech: 通过 J-invariant 遮挡使单幅 noisy image 同时提供输入与 held-out 监督目标。
models.core_mech_en: Formalizes single-image self-supervised denoising via J-invariant functions whose prediction for pixel subset J does not depend on the observed noisy values in J.
models.input_desc: 单幅含噪图像 y
models.input_en: Single noisy image y (no paired second scan and no clean ground truth)
models.output_desc: 由多次 J-invariant 预测聚合的去噪图像 x_hat
models.output_en: Denoised image x̂ predicted from J-invariant masked neighborhoods

models.title: Noise2Void
models.paper_title: Noise2Void - Learning Denoising From Single Noisy Images
models.core_mech: Noise2Void 通过输入操纵构造 blind spot，只从单张 noisy 图像回归其被隐藏中心，而非需要成对噪声或 clean target。
models.core_mech_en: Implements practical single-image blind-spot denoising by randomly masking center pixels via neighborhood replacement so a standard U-Net predicts held-out pixels.
models.input_desc: 一张噪声图像；训练时随机选取中心像素并用邻域值替换
models.input_en: Single noisy image (with random center pixels replaced by neighboring values during training)
models.output_desc: 每个像素的条件期望估计形成的去噪图像
models.output_en: Denoised image estimate x̂ from a single forward pass

models.title: RED-Net
models.paper_title: Image Restoration Using Very Deep Convolutional Encoder-Decoder Networks with Symmetric Skip Connections
models.core_mech: 相较普通 autoencoder，RED-Net 在每个镜像卷积—反卷积层之间建立对称加法 skip，而不只保留少数 U-Net 尺度跳连。
models.core_mech_en: Deep symmetric convolutional–deconvolutional autoencoder connected by layer-by-layer additive residual skip connections at every mirrored depth.
models.input_desc: 含噪、压缩或受退化影响的图像
models.input_en: Noisy, blurry, or low-dose degraded image
models.output_desc: 恢复后的高质量图像或残差校正图
models.output_en: Restored clean image recovered via multi-depth additive residual shortcuts

models.title: SwinIR
models.paper_title: SwinIR: Image Restoration Using Swin Transformer
models.core_mech: SwinIR 把多个带卷积残差的 RSTB 置于浅层卷积和任务重建头之间，以移窗注意力服务高分辨率恢复。
models.core_mech_en: Sandwiches multiple Residual Swin Transformer Blocks (RSTBs, each ending in a 3×3 convolutional residual) between a shallow CNN extractor and a reconstruction head.
models.input_desc: 低分辨率、含噪或受压缩伪影影响的图像
models.input_en: Low-resolution, noisy, or artifact-corrupted image
models.output_desc: 超分、去噪或 JPEG artifact reduction 后的图像
models.output_en: Super-resolved, denoised, or artifact-restored high-resolution image

models.title: Restormer
models.paper_title: Restormer: Efficient Transformer for High-Resolution Image Restoration
models.core_mech: Restormer 用 MDTA 在通道维做转置注意力，并以 GDFN 门控深度卷积替代普通 Transformer FFN。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces spatial N×N self-attention with Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention (MDTA) across channels (C×C) paired with a Gated-Dconv Feed-Forward Network (GDFN).
models.input_desc: 高分辨率受退化图像
models.input_en: High-resolution degraded image
models.output_desc: 去噪、去雨、去模糊等恢复图像
models.output_en: Restored high-resolution image

models.title: Spatial Transformer Network
models.paper_title: Spatial Transformer Networks
models.core_mech: 定位网络预测变换参数，grid generator 与可微 sampler 将任务梯度传回几何坐标。
models.core_mech_en: Predicts geometric transformation parameters θ via a localization network, generates a transformed sampling grid, and warps feature maps via a differentiable sampler.
models.input_desc: 输入特征图/图像 U
models.input_en: Input image or feature map U
models.output_desc: 按学习变换重采样后的 V
models.output_en: Spatially warped feature map V resampled over learned coordinates T_θ(G)

models.title: VoxelMorph
models.paper_title: VoxelMorph: A Learning Framework for Deformable Medical Image Registration
models.core_mech: 3D U-Net 一次前向预测 dense displacement，并用可微 warping、图像相似度和平滑项无监督训练。
models.core_mech_en: Amortizes pairwise 3D deformable registration into a single U-Net forward pass predicting a dense displacement field u trained unsupervised via image similarity and diffusion smoothness.
models.input_desc: 移动图像 m 与固定图像 f
models.input_en: Pair of 3D moving volume m and fixed volume f
models.output_desc: 稠密形变 phi 及配准图像 m∘phi
models.output_en: Dense 3D deformation field φ = Id + u (or velocity field integrated via scaling-and-squaring) and warped volume m ∘ φ

models.title: GradICON
models.paper_title: GradICON: Approximate Diffeomorphisms via Gradient Inverse Consistency
models.core_mech: 通过双向预测与复合映射 Jacobian 的 gradient inverse-consistency 正则获得近似微分同胚。
models.core_mech_en: Enforces diffeomorphic regularity without tuning sensitive multi-scale smoothness weights by penalizing the Frobenius norm of the composed forward–backward Jacobian deviation from identity.
models.input_desc: 图像 A 与图像 B
models.input_en: Ordered pairs (I^A, I^B) and (I^B, I^A) fed symmetrically to a registration network
models.output_desc: 近似互逆、规则的双向配准映射 Phi_AB 与 Phi_BA
models.output_en: Approximately diffeomorphic, inverse-consistent forward map Φ^AB and backward map Φ^BA

models.title: uniGradICON
models.paper_title: uniGradICON: A Foundation Model for Medical Image Registration
models.core_mech: 将 GradICON 在异质多数据集上联合训练为单一通用注册器，支持 zero-shot 与目标域微调。
models.core_mech_en: Trains a single multi-step GradICON architecture jointly across heterogeneous multi-organ, multi-modality datasets to serve as a zero-shot registration foundation model.
models.input_desc: 来自多解剖、多模态、多数据集的 moving/fixed 图像对
models.input_en: 3D fixed/moving volume pair from any anatomical region or modality (zero-shot or rapid fine-tuning)
models.output_desc: 新任务上的 zero-shot 或微调双向形变
models.output_en: Diffeomorphic bidirectional deformation fields Φ^AB, Φ^BA

models.title: DiffPose
models.paper_title: Intraoperative 2D/3D Image Registration via Differentiable X-ray Rendering
models.core_mech: 合成 DRR 训练的 pose initializer 与可微 X-ray renderer 驱动的 SE(3) 测试时优化闭环结合。
models.core_mech_en: Couples a patient-specific SE(3) pose initializer (trained self-supervised on synthetic DRRs) with test-time gradient optimization through a differentiable X-ray ray-casting renderer.
models.input_desc: 术前 CT 体 V、术中 2D X-ray y、投影标定参数
models.input_en: Preoperative 3D CT volume V, intraoperative 2D X-ray fluoroscopy image y, and C-arm intrinsic calibration
models.output_desc: CT 到 X-ray 的刚体 SE(3) 位姿 T_hat
models.output_en: Sub-millimeter 6-DoF rigid pose T̂ ∈ SE(3) aligning preoperative CT to intraoperative X-ray

models.title: LapIRN
models.paper_title: Laplacian Pyramid Networks for Fast Deformable Registration of Large Deformation
models.core_mech: LapIRN 把配准写成 Laplacian 金字塔上的三层残差流：每层先 warp，再让下一层只修正剩余误差。
models.core_mech_en: Decomposes large-deformation 3D registration into a 3-level coarse-to-fine Laplacian image pyramid where each level warps the previous estimate and refines only the residual displacement.
models.input_desc: moving 体积 Im 与 fixed 体积 If
models.input_en: 3D moving volume I_m and fixed volume I_f decomposed into a 3-level Gaussian/Laplacian pyramid
models.output_desc: 组合位移场、形变后的 moving 图像与可选 diffeomorphic 场
models.output_en: Composed full-resolution deformation field (or stationary velocity diffeomorphism) and warped volume

models.title: TransMorph
models.paper_title: TransMorph: Transformer for Unsupervised Medical Image Registration
models.core_mech: TransMorph 用层级 Swin encoder 取代纯 CNN 配准编码器，同时保留 U-Net 式 decoder 和可微 warping。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces the convolutional encoder in VoxelMorph with a 3D hierarchical Swin Transformer encoder while retaining a convolutional U-Net decoder and Spatial Transformer warping.
models.input_desc: moving 图像 Im 与 fixed 图像 If
models.input_en: Concatenated 3D moving and fixed volumes (I_m, I_f)
models.output_desc: 稠密位移场 φ、warped moving 图像及可选不确定性估计
models.output_en: Dense 3D displacement field φ, warped moving image I_m ∘ φ, and optional Bayesian uncertainty

models.title: IDIR
models.paper_title: Implicit Neural Representations for Deformable Image Registration
models.core_mech: IDIR 将位移场本身作为坐标神经场，并在测试图像对上直接优化，而不是由训练好的网络一次预测 flow。
models.core_mech_en: Parameterizes the continuous 3D deformation field φ(x) = x + u_θ(x) for a single image pair directly as a coordinate-based Implicit Neural Representation (SIREN MLP) optimized at test time.
models.input_desc: 一对 fixed/moving 图像及在图像域采样的连续坐标 x
models.input_en: Continuous 3D spatial coordinates x ∈ [-1,1]³ sampled over a fixed/moving volume pair (I_f, I_m)
models.output_desc: 可在任意坐标查询的连续位移场 uθ(x) 和 warped moving 图像
models.output_en: Resolution-independent continuous deformation field φ_θ(x) with exact autograd spatial derivatives

models.title: DeepDRR
models.paper_title: DeepDRR: A Catalyst for Machine Learning in Fluoroscopy-Guided Procedures
models.core_mech: DeepDRR 不是纯 GAN 渲染器，而是 3D 材料分解网络、解析材料/能谱 ray tracing、学习散射和解析噪声的组合 forward model。
models.core_mech_en: Physics-based X-ray fluoroscopy simulator combining CNN 3D tissue material decomposition, analytical energy-dependent Beer–Lambert ray-casting, learned Rayleigh/Compton scatter, and quantum noise.
models.input_desc: 患者 CT、X-ray 源—探测器几何、能谱和曝光参数
models.input_en: Volumetric 3D CT scan, C-arm source–detector geometry, X-ray spectrum E, and photon flux
models.output_desc: 含材料衰减、散射和噪声的逼真数字重建 X-ray/fluoroscopy
models.output_en: Photorealistic synthetic fluoroscopy / Digitally Reconstructed Radiograph (DRR) with physical scatter and noise

models.title: X2CT-GAN
models.paper_title: X2CT-GAN: Reconstructing CT from Biplanar X-Rays with Generative Adversarial Networks
models.core_mech: 双正交 2D 编码器将特征提升并融合到 3D，再以体素重建和 3D adversarial loss 联合监督。
models.core_mech_en: Lifts features from two orthogonal (bi-planar PA + lateral) 2D chest X-rays into 3D via backprojection-inspired feature expansion and cross-view fusion supervised by 3D voxel + GAN losses.
models.input_desc: 正位与侧位两幅正交 X-ray
models.input_en: Pair of orthogonal posterior–anterior (PA) and lateral 2D chest radiographs
models.output_desc: 端到端生成的 3D CT 体
models.output_en: Synthesized 3D volumetric chest CT tensor

models.title: NeRF
models.paper_title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
models.core_mech: 位置编码坐标 MLP 预测连续密度与视角相关颜色，再沿相机射线做可微体渲染。
models.core_mech_en: Represents a continuous 3D scene as a 5D coordinate MLP (x,y,z,θ,φ) → (σ, c) with Fourier positional encoding, optimized via differentiable emission–absorption volume rendering.
models.input_desc: 带相机内外参的多视角 RGB 图像与采样射线
models.input_en: 3D spatial coordinates x=(x,y,z) and 2D viewing direction d=(θ,φ) along calibrated camera rays
models.output_desc: 新视角渲染图像及连续密度/颜色场
models.output_en: Volume density σ(x), view-dependent RGB radiance c(x,d), and rendered 2D novel views

models.title: NAF
models.paper_title: Neural Attenuation Fields for Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction
models.core_mech: 以 hash-encoded 坐标网络表示 X-ray attenuation，并用 Beer–Lambert 重投影误差逐病例优化。
models.core_mech_en: Rewrites NeRF for cone-beam CT by replacing view-dependent emission–absorption with an isotropic X-ray linear attenuation field μ(x) optimized via Beer–Lambert reprojection error and hash encoding.
models.input_desc: 稀疏视角 CBCT 投影 y、每幅投影的射线几何
models.input_en: 3D spatial coordinates x along calibrated X-ray source-to-detector rays and sparse 2D CBCT projections y
models.output_desc: 连续 X-ray attenuation field mu(x) 与可查询 3D 重建
models.output_en: Continuous 3D X-ray attenuation coefficient field μ_θ(x) queried at arbitrary voxel grids

models.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting
models.paper_title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
models.core_mech: 显式优化各向异性 3D Gaussians，并通过屏幕空间 splatting 与自适应增密实现实时 radiance rendering。
models.core_mech_en: Represents 3D scenes explicitly as millions of anisotropic 3D Gaussians (position, covariance, opacity, spherical harmonics) rendered in real time via differentiable tile-based rasterization.
models.input_desc: 带标定多视角 RGB 图像与 SfM/点云初始化
models.input_en: Calibrated multi-view images and initial sparse point cloud
models.output_desc: 可实时新视角渲染的显式 3D Gaussian 集合
models.output_en: Explicit set of anisotropic 3D Gaussians supporting >100 FPS real-time novel-view synthesis

models.title: pixelNeRF
models.paper_title: pixelNeRF: Neural Radiance Fields from One or Few Images
models.core_mech: pixelNeRF 将每个 3D 点与其投影像素的 CNN 特征绑定，使 NeRF 从单场景优化器变为跨场景条件模型。
models.core_mech_en: Conditions a coordinate NeRF MLP on pixel-aligned 2D CNN feature vectors projected from 1 or a few input views, turning NeRF from a per-scene optimizer into a feed-forward cross-scene prior.
models.input_desc: 一张或少量带相机位姿的参考图像，以及目标相机射线
models.input_en: 1 to K calibrated input images + query 3D point x projected into each input view's camera coordinates
models.output_desc: 目标视角 RGB 图像和隐式密度/辐射场
models.output_en: Feed-forward novel-view rendering and 3D volumetric density field from sparse views

models.title: Instant-NGP
models.paper_title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding
models.core_mech: Instant-NGP 的速度来自可学习多分辨率 hash-grid encoding 和空空间跳跃，而不是更深的 NeRF MLP。
models.core_mech_en: Replaces fixed sinusoidal positional encodings with a multi-resolution hierarchy of learnable hash tables paired with a tiny fused-CUDA MLP, accelerating neural fields by 100×–1000×.
models.input_desc: 3D 坐标、观察方向及训练相机射线
models.input_en: Continuous 3D coordinate x ∈ R³ mapped across L resolution grids via spatial hashing
models.output_desc: 快速优化的 density/color 场与实时新视角渲染
models.output_en: Concatenated L×F interpolated feature vector decoded in microseconds into density/attenuation/SDF

models.title: MedNeRF
models.paper_title: MedNeRF: Medical Neural Radiance Fields for Reconstructing 3D-Aware CT-Projections from a Single X-Ray
models.core_mech: MedNeRF 把 NeRF 置于 GAN 式跨病例生成先验中，以 shape/appearance latent 从单 X-ray 合成视角，而非逐场景多视图优化。
models.core_mech_en: Adapts GIRAFFE/GRAF 3D-aware generative radiance fields to X-ray projections, disentangling 3D shape and appearance latents to synthesize continuous-angle CT projections from a single X-ray.
models.input_desc: 训练时为未配对的 2D X-ray 与采样相机位姿；推理时以单张 X-ray 约束患者潜变量
models.input_en: Unpaired 2D DRR/X-ray projections during GAN training; a single 2D X-ray during test-time latent inversion
